### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues were identified for the change to handle empty successful PUT responses. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes #370 by accepting empty successful PUT responses, preventing false parsing errors and unnecessary fallback requests after bulk expectation updates. **Changes:** - Returns `{}` for empty 2xx PUT responses when `raw=False`, leaving raw-call behavior unchanged. - Adds regression tests for empty-body success and continued parsing errors on nonempty, non-JSON responses. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `test/​apis/​inject_expectation/​test_inject_expectation.py` | Tests bulk updates with empty and invalid response bodies. | | `pyoaev/​client.py` | Skips JSON parsing for empty successful non-raw PUT responses. |
Review effort: Balanced
